verdict.rationale: Signifyd publishes a structured per-endpoint REST API reference covering Sale, Checkout, Get Decision, Chargeback, Representment Outcome and Webhook creation, plus authentication guidance and markdown versions of reference pages. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it console, runnable request/response examples, sandbox execution from the docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
